how_it_works.title: How Workwyn Works
how_it_works.description: A simple three-step process that puts ideas first and lets talent find its own place.
how_it_works.step_1_desc: Describe the project you want to bring to life — the problem, the opportunity, and where you are today. No job descriptions needed.

how_it_works.step_3_desc: Review pitches, find your match, and start building together. The best teams emerge organically from shared passion.

blog_detail.p1: Starting a new project is exciting, but it can also be overwhelming. Whether you're a first-time founder or a serial entrepreneur, the journey always starts with a single step: sharing your idea with the world and finding the right people to help you build it.
blog_detail.p2: One of the biggest mistakes people make is trying to do everything alone. The most successful projects are built by diverse teams with complementary skills. A great developer needs a great designer, a brilliant marketer needs a talented product person, and a visionary founder needs operational support.
blog_detail.p3: The key is to focus on clear communication. When you share your project vision, be specific about what you're building, why it matters, and what kind of help you need. People are naturally drawn to projects that have a clear purpose and passionate founders behind them.
blog_detail.p4: Remember: it's not about having a perfect idea. It's about having the courage to share it, the openness to receive feedback, and the determination to iterate until you find what works. Start small, learn fast, and build meaningful connections along the way.
blog_detail.cta_text: Ready to start your own project journey?

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about using Workwyn to share ideas and find teammates.
faq.a1: Workwyn is a platform where you can share your project ideas and find people who want to collaborate. Think of it as a matchmaking service for creators and builders.
faq.a2: Yes! Posting your project vision and browsing other projects is completely free. We believe great ideas should be accessible to everyone.
faq.q3: How do I find teammates for my project?
faq.a3: Simply post your project vision with details about what you're building. Interested people will send you pitch messages explaining how they can contribute.
faq.a4: A Pitch Deck is a more detailed proposal that includes slides about your skills, what you can contribute, your timeline, and why you're the right fit for the project.
faq.a5: Absolutely! You can pitch to as many projects as you like. It's a great way to explore different ideas and find the best fit for your skills.
faq.q6: How do I communicate with project owners?
faq.a6: Once you send a pitch, the project owner can review it and accept or decline. After acceptance, you can discuss further details through the platform.
faq.a7: We take data privacy seriously. Your personal information is encrypted and we never share your data with third parties without your consent.

about.title: About Workwyn
about.description: We believe every great project starts with an idea and the right team. Workwyn connects visionaries with collaborators to make ideas happen.
about.mission_desc: To democratize project collaboration by removing traditional barriers like job descriptions and formal applications. We want to create a world where anyone with an idea can find the right people to build it — and where talented people can discover projects that truly excite them.
about.val1_desc: We believe the idea matters more than titles or resumes. Everyone has the potential to create something amazing.
about.val2_desc: We're building a supportive community where people help each other grow and succeed together.
about.val3_desc: The best work happens when people are genuinely excited about what they're building.
